For a subgroup L of a group G, let LG denote the largest normal subgroup of
G contained in L. If M ◁ G, then we say that G nearly splits over M if there is a
subgroup N ⩽ G such that |G : N | = ∞, |G : M N | < ∞, and (M ∩ N )G = 1.
   Let G be any group, and H a normal subgroup of prime order. Is it true that
ψ(G) ∩ H = 1 if and only if G nearly splits over H?                 M. K. Azarian
